comment: Runtime allow/deny policy for job source execution. If enforce=true, enabled disallowed sources are blocked.

greenhouse.rationale: Public job board endpoint intended for listing jobs

lever.rationale: Public postings API for company boards

ashby.rationale: Public posting API when tenant exposes board

linkedin.rationale: No unrestricted public jobs API; automated scraping may violate terms

indeed.rationale: General public job ingestion is partnership-restricted

google_jobs.rationale: No official public jobs listing API for unrestricted scraping

glassdoor.rationale: No unrestricted public listings API for general scraping

craigslist.rationale: Requires explicit review before automated collection
